name: Nanji, Sono Muku Naru Tamashii de Yoru o Samayou Nakare
original_name: 汝、その無垢なる魂で夜を彷徨うなかれ
source:
If you walk alone on the moon night, you will meet the witch of the moon. 
Such city legend flows in the city of Mahoroba. 
Main character is a freelancer who also has part-time work at convenience store "New Life". One night he meets a witch...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
据说，在月夜独自行走，就会遇见月之魔女。
这则都市传说流传于真幌羽市。
主角是一名自由职业者，同时在“新生活”便利店打工。某天夜里，他遇见了一位魔女……

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
